description: 1. Move secrets to Kubernetes Secrets objects using proper encryption tools like Bitnami Sealed Secrets or KSOPS. 2. Replace hardcoded values with references to sealed secrets or external secret managers. 3. Integrate secret management into CI/CD pipelines to ensure secrets are never stored in plain text in version control.

example.after:
# Before: Hardcoded secret in YAML
# apiVersion: v1
# kind: Secret
# metadata:
#   name: my-secret
# data:
#   password: cGFzc3dvcmQ=  # base64 encoded 'password'

# After: Using SealedSecrets
# apiVersion: bitnami.com/v1alpha1
# kind: SealedSecret
# metadata:
#   name: my-sealed-secret
# spec:
#   encryptedData:
#     password: AgC...
#   template:
#     metadata:
#       name: my-secret
#       namespace: default

fix_pattern.instructions: 1. Move secrets to Kubernetes Secrets objects using proper encryption tools like Bitnami Sealed Secrets or KSOPS. 2. Replace hardcoded values with references to sealed secrets or external secret managers. 3. Integrate secret management into CI/CD pipelines to ensure secrets are never stored in plain text in version control.
